title: Overly broad file permissions (shell) — review required
description: Code in shell grants world-writable or world-readable permissions: chmods+[0-7]*777. Any local user can then modify or read the file. This lexical rule flags the grant; the reviewer confirms the breadth is intended or tightens it.
remediation: Grant the narrowest workable mode (0755/0644 least privilege) and rely on group ownership instead of world bits.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the mode regardless of file sensitivity.
